notes.title: Last Update: Hate Free Heroes Leaves Steam - Our appreciation Over the Years
notes.notes: [p]Last Update: Words from the developers,[/p][p][/p][p]We greatly appreciate everyone who showed support for this game over the years. [b][i]Hate Free Heroes[/i][/b] is a humorous, lighthearted and heart warming game that was a joy to create and a game that is very dear to our heart. Originally greenlit on Steam (does anyone remember greenlight?), [b][i]Hate Free Heroes[/i][/b] received support from the Steam community and was approved to be put in Steam’s store (this was a great honor back then). An indie game could not get on Steam unless it was greenlit back in those days. We later made an updated version with 3D features and an improved 2D version that was re-released together, this is the game that is now leaving Steam for good. This is our final "Hurrah" for [b][i]Hate Free Heroes"[/i][/b], thank you all for your support.[/p][p][/p][p]Times change and so does the demand for certain games. [b][i]“Hate Free Heroes”[/i][/b] is now leaving the market place for good. We are reducing our catalog to make room for newer and better projects. Maybe one day this project can be re-done with a more advanced engine and improved graphics, but there are no guarantees. We hope everyone enjoyed the game and will keep it in memory.[/p][p] [/p][p]We are giving the chance for people to get this game before we say goodbye to our game for the last time. June 26 (Steam Summer Sale) 50% off, will be the last opportunity to get [b][i]Hate Free Heroes[/i][/b] before it will be removed. After that, we will no longer support this game. It will no longer be available to buy on Steam or anywhere else. [b][i]*Please inform us if this game is still being sold after it is removed.[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1690790/Hate_Free_Heroes_RPG_2D3D_RPG_Enhanced_Leaving_Steam/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]When a game is removed from the Steam store, we get questions about why it was removed. Unfortunately, we will no longer have time for this game and we are doing our best to inform everyone now about it's retirement. If you don’t have the game and you are interested to own it, the Summer Sale will be the last chance to get the game before we remove it for good.[/p][p] [/p][p]Thank you everyone for your interest and your support of “Hate Free Heroes”. I don’t like to throw the word “love” around loosely but, I love you all![/p]

notes.title: Hate Free Heroes Major Update! 4.0
notes.notes:
We added a major update to Hate Free Heroes RPG and Hate Free Heroes Tactics 4.0 versions.

Each version has been updated to now include the Enhanced 2D and 3D versions of Hate Free Heroes RPG and Hate Free Heroes Tactics (browser based strategy mmo). You will get access to all 3 versions with either purchase. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26545584/a57de65201b2ff8fa439f19846bcd90def38555f.png[/img]

The 2D Enhanced version has been added fully updated with all new features, enhancements but all the fun you expect from the original. If you have lower PC system specs, you can enjoy the 2D version without any issues. You can also select the 3D version and play and/or play the Browser Based MMO at anytime.

Get either version below to get access to ALL 3!

notes.title: The Game Is Coming Back (With Updates)
notes.notes:
We are bring this game back as "Hate Free Heroes Tactics" and will be available independently here: 

https://www.tactics.hatefreeheroes.com

The game has been updated with a few new features, fixes and improvements.

Everyone who purchased the game before or has an account from the previous game will have access to join once again. Simply login. If you used a valid email, you can always request for your account info if you forgot. 

*This opportunity announcement will only happen once and we will not provide access or login support for previous accounts. We decided to give everyone who supported our previous version an opportunity to play without having to start all over. All agencies have been removed and any new agency must be started from scratch.

Hope to see you back!

notes.title: New Price, New Name
notes.notes:
We made a few changes and updates to the game, mainly the official name. We wanted to make sure that players were not getting confused with "Hate Free Heroes RPG" as there has been some confusion in the past, so we changed the name from "Hate Free Heroes Online" to "Agents of Aggro City Online".

We also changed the price of the game to make it more affordable and to attract more players. We would like to keep this game a one time payment model that is fun and affordable to play and doesn't require one to "pay to win" at.

We also updated the tutorial or orientation section of the game giving more info on how to play. More updates soon.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/658420/Agents_of_Aggro_City_Online/
